For the Republicans, there are 5 distinct people. They can be arranged within their block in $5!$ ways.
For the Independent, there is 1 person. They can be arranged in $1! = 1$ way.

So, the total number of ways should be:
(Number of ways to arrange blocks) $\times$ (Number of ways to arrange Democrats) $\times$ (Number of ways to arrange Republicans) $\times$ (Number of ways to arrange Independent)
$= 2! \times 5! \times 5! \times 1!$
$= 2 \times 120 \times 120 \times 1$
